tips.text: Pledge to one syndicate, rank it to 2, then switch pledges and do the other.
Play normal missions while pledged; 15% of all Affinity becomes Standing in that syndicate.
Take the Rathbone part as the free pick for reaching Rank 2; it skips that part's 20,000 Standing.
Save Syndicate Alert medallions for the syndicate you are not pledged to; they ignore the daily cap.
Expect Standing with one syndicate to drain its opposed syndicate; Red Veil costs Cephalon Suda and Arbiters of Hexis, New Loka costs Steel Meridian.
Skip Alerts for an opposed syndicate while farming; losing Standing can demote you and make you sacrifice items to rank up again.
Treat Rathbone as a plain Standing grind; there is no RNG, only two syndicate ranks.
